title: Authentic Experience
text: Great experience. The show was authentic and the performers were amazing. Highly recommend going to a flamenco show when in Granada!
author: raduschirila

title: A must-do in Granada!
text: I had a really enjoyable experience at Cueva Los Amayas. The performers were incredibly talented, and their energy was amazing from start to finish. The cave setting made it feel so intimate and authentic. It is truly a great experience when you are visiting Granada—highly recommended!
author: Nickoli76

title: Flamenco Granada
text: A Brilliant experience. The performance was fabulous with talented dancers and a brilliant guitar player in a magical setting. It felt very authentic. I would highly recommend.
author: Kathy_H

title: Amazing show in a fun...
text: Amazing show in a fun atmosphere. Felt more authentic to other shows. Fun way to experience the caves that the Sacromonte area is known for.
author: Amanda_G

title: Amazing show!
text: Prepare themselves for an authentic and energized experience. The musicians and dancers were absolutely skilled and vibrant.
author: Jack_L

title: Beautiful Granada
text: Excellent experience. The place is wonderful. It is worth seeing and visiting. The guide gave us an exceptional tour.
author: marianadW6534AO

title: Feeling
text: I enjoyed it a lot and they were great professionals who conveyed the essence of flamenco
author: 662juanantoniot

title: Passionate!!
text: A magical night of passionate flamenco song and dance.  The whole experience exceeded our  expectations.  A fabulous immersive show of incredible skill from the whole group — amazing footwork, dancing, singing, clapping.  Elena, Antonio, and others were amazing.  We were served a drink before which was enough for us.  We would absolutely do it again, and again.
author: Gaby_D

title: Such a great performance!
text: Incredible show, amazing performers so much passion. Venue is super cool and intimate. Great value for the performance. Highly recommend this show, get there 15-20 mins early as the queues form for seats, though not really a bad seat in the house.
author: I7280IBramis

title: Excellent cave experience!
text: We had an absolutely fantastic time at the flamenco show! It exceeded our expectations in every way. The intimate cave setting made the experience feel incredibly personal, with the performers right in front of us. The dancers were phenomenal, and their passion, intensity, and energy were truly unforgettable. The entire atmosphere was incredible, and we thoroughly enjoyed every minute of it. We would absolutely love to attend another show on our next visit. Highly recommended for anyone looking for an authentic and memorable flamenco experience!
author: roberts20000
